contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Playable Keyboard->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
contracts.payload: { type: 'noteOn'; pitch: number /* MIDI note number 0-127 */; frequency: number /* Hz */; velocity: number /* 0-1 */; portamento: number /* glide time ms */ } | { type: 'noteOff'; pitch: number /* MIDI note number 0-127 */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
contracts.payload: { attack: number /* seconds */; decay: number /* seconds */; sustain: number /* 0-1 level */; release: number /* seconds */; amount: number /* 0-100 percent, VCA gain depth */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: LFO Modulation Panel->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
contracts.payload: { active: boolean /* true only when destination = pitch */; value: number /* bipolar -1 to 1, current waveform output scaled by depth */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
contracts.payload: { osc1: { wave: 'sin' | 'tri' | 'saw' | 'sqr'; oct: number /* -2 to 2 */; detune: number /* -50 to 50 cents */ }; osc2: { wave: 'sin' | 'tri' | 'saw' | 'sqr'; oct: number /* -2 to 2 */; detune: number /* -50 to 50 cents */ }; sub: { on: boolean; level: number /* 0-100 percent */ }; noise: { type: 'wht' | 'pnk'; level: number /* 0-100 percent */ }; mix: number /* -100 to 100, osc1<->osc2 balance */; unison: number /* 1-7 voices */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Playable Keyboard->Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel
Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel
contracts.payload: { attack: number /* seconds */; decay: number /* seconds */; sustain: number /* 0-1 level */; release: number /* seconds */; amount: number /* 0-100 percent */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Effects Rack->Y2K Synth: Master Output & Oscilloscope
contracts.payload: { samples: number[] /* processed audio waveform, values roughly -1 to 1 */; mix: number /* 0-100 wet/dry percent */; activeCount: number /* number of engaged effect units */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Step Sequencer->Y2K Synth: Playable Keyboard
contracts.payload: { type: 'noteOn'; pitch: number /* MIDI note number 0-127 */; velocity: number /* 0-1 */; gate: number /* gate length ms */ } | { type: 'noteOff'; pitch: number /* MIDI note number 0-127 */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
contracts.payload: { sources: Array<{ id: 'osc1' | 'osc2' | 'sub' | 'noise'; wave: 'sin' | 'tri' | 'saw' | 'sqr' | 'wht' | 'pnk'; on: boolean; level: number /* 0-1 relative gain in the mix */ }>; unison: number /* 1-7 voices */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
contracts.payload: { attack: number /* seconds, 0.001-2 */; decay: number /* seconds, 0.001-2 */; sustain: number /* 0-1 level */; release: number /* seconds, 0.001-3 */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: LFO Modulation Panel->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
contracts.payload: { active: boolean /* true only when destination = filter */; value: number /* -1 to 1 bipolar current LFO output already scaled by depth */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
contracts.payload: { type: 'lp24' | 'lp12' | 'bp12' | 'hp12' | 'notch'; cutoff: number /* Hz, 20-18000 */; reso: number /* 0-100 percent */; env: number /* -100 to 100 envelope amount */; lfo: number /* -100 to 100 LFO amount */; track: number /* 0-100 percent keytrack */; drive: number /* 0-100 */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Filter Module->Y2K Synth: Effects Rack
contracts.payload: { level: number /* 0-1 post-filter signal level */; cutoff: number /* Hz, 20-18000 current cutoff */; brightness: number /* 0-1 perceived brightness from cutoff+drive */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: Effects Rack
contracts.payload: { units: Array<{ id: 'rev' | 'dly' | 'cho' | 'dst' | 'bit'; on: boolean; val: number /* effect's main param in its own unit */ }>; order: Array<'rev' | 'dly' | 'cho' | 'dst' | 'bit'> /* signal-chain order */; mix: number /* 0-100 wet/dry percent */ }

contracts.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: LFO Modulation Panel
contracts.payload: { wave: 'sin' | 'tri' | 'saw' | 'sqr' | 'snh'; rate: number /* Hz, 0.05-20, used when sync=false */; div: number /* 0-6 index into sync divisions, used when sync=true */; depth: number /* 0-100 percent */; sync: boolean /* tempo sync on */; destination: 'pitch' | 'filter' }

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Playable Keyboard->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
channelList.description: On key press/release (or pitch-bend/glide change), emit note-on/note-off with the MIDI pitch/frequency, velocity, and portamento time; the oscillator bank sets its running pitch to that frequency and starts/stops the voice accordingly.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Playable Keyboard->Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel
channelList.description: On key press emit a gate-on trigger (with velocity) and on release emit gate-off; the envelope panel starts its attack/decay/sustain stage on gate-on and begins the release stage on gate-off.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
channelList.description: Continuously outputs the mixed oscillator audio signal into the filter's input as the next stage of the signal chain.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Filter Module->Y2K Synth: Effects Rack
channelList.description: Continuously outputs the filtered audio signal into the effects rack's input as the next stage of the chain.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
channelList.description: Sends the computed amplitude contour as the VCA gain envelope shaping oscillator output volume per note.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
channelList.description: Sends the same envelope contour to modulate filter cutoff, scaled by the filter module's Envelope Amount control.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: LFO Modulation Panel->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
channelList.description: When destination = pitch, sends a bipolar modulation signal (waveform at set rate, scaled by depth) that offsets oscillator pitch for vibrato.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: LFO Modulation Panel->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
channelList.description: When destination = filter, sends a bipolar modulation signal that sweeps the filter cutoff, further scaled by the filter's LFO Amount control.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Effects Rack->Y2K Synth: Master Output & Oscilloscope
channelList.description: Outputs the final wet/dry processed audio to the master stage for gain control and visualization.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: Oscillator Bank
channelList.description: On selecting/loading a preset, pushes the stored oscillator parameter block, which the oscillator bank applies to its controls.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: Filter Module
channelList.description: On preset load, pushes the stored filter parameter block, which the filter module applies to type, cutoff, resonance and modulation amounts.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: ADSR Envelope Panel
channelList.description: On preset load, pushes stored ADSR and amount values, which the envelope panel applies to its sliders and curve.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: LFO Modulation Panel
channelList.description: On preset load, pushes stored LFO parameters (waveform, rate, depth, sync, destination), which the LFO panel applies.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Preset Browser->Y2K Synth: Effects Rack
channelList.description: On preset load, pushes stored effect enable states, parameters, mix and order, which the effects rack applies.

channelList.id: Y2K Synth: Step Sequencer->Y2K Synth: Playable Keyboard
channelList.description: While the transport is running, on each active step emit a note-on/note-off event (pitch, velocity, gate length, timing derived from BPM/swing/arp mode); the keyboard plays these through the voice and highlights the matching keys.
